description:
As a user
  I want to complete the full Gajab flow from login to order confirmation
  So that core shopping, bargaining, payment, and savings validation are covered

elements.name: Complete Gajab end to end flow with fallback handling

steps.name: I launch Gajab application sign-in page
I enter mobile number in sign-in form
I accept age confirmation and terms in sign-in form

embeddings.data: Age confirmation and terms accepted successfully.

steps.name: I should see sign-in terms selected
I explore deal of the day and kitchen product flow

elements.name: Complete Gajab end to end flow with full business statements

steps.name: I navigate to gajab website
I click on log in or sign-up button
I enter mobile number and request otp
I enter default otp "123456" and submit
I should see login success message
I enter pincode and select location
selected pincode should be reflected on home page
I capture gajab deal of the day details
I email deal product image name and asking price to configured email
I identify most bargained product under trending products
if bargain count ties I should pick first product in scroll order
I verify latest live order card
I fetch latest live order name and city
I capture screenshot of latest live order details
I open just bargained product section using view all
I identify cheapest product among most bargained list
I open toys and games category tab
I select brand "SERA'S BASKET" from left filter
I set product price range from "427" to "727"
I open product "Classic 15.7 Inch Soft Tip Dartboard Game Set"
I start bargaining on selected product
I continue bargaining for 3 attempts
I accept offered bargain price
I click buy now
I select payment method "Pay Online" and proceed to pay
I choose net banking and select any available bank
I confirm payment success
I should verify order placed successfully
I open my bargains section
I should verify savings for placed order
if any specified product price filter brand or dependency is unavailable I document issue with evidence
I apply a reasonable fallback approach and continue validation

name: Gajab - End to End Purchase and Bargain Journey
